title: Easy California Roll Sushi Salad
description: This easy, yummy California roll salad is a great choice for anyone who loves California rolls, but doesn't have the patience or the equipment to make their own.
ingredients: 1.5 cups sushi rice, or Japanese short-grain white rice
1 tablespoon soy sauce, or to taste

steps.text: Rinse rice in a strainer under cold water until water runs clear. Transfer rice to a medium saucepan, add 3 cups water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook under rice is tender and water is absorbed, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine rice wine vinegar, sugar, and sake in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on high until sugar is completely dissolved, about 1 minute.

Place cooked rice in a large bowl. Stir in vinegar mixture until well combined and let sit for 2 minutes. Stir again. Add imitation crabmeat, cucumber, and chopped avocado; mix well. Use soy sauce to season individual portions.
